'''TZ-6 executive shuttle''' was a type of luxury [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] produced by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] that was available during [[3640 BBY]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] owned one such shuttle called [[Prosperity (shuttle)|''Prosperity'']] as part of his cover as a wealthy businessman during the [[Operation End Game]].
